summary: Layout and reflow were hardened against invalid frame-tree states, weak references, and tricky positioning cases, including sticky positioning, SVG text, absolute-positioned content, and nested iframe printing. Firefox also improved caret placement after paragraph-ending newlines, SVG intrinsic sizing, scroll snapping, automatic line clamping, and restoration of scroll positions without emitting misleading scroll events. **These changes make complex pages more stable and predictable as content is laid out, resized, printed, or restored.**
